literature_notes: The sole ledger line (L1) describes an HA-tagged full-length TEM8 construct, where TEM8 is ANTXR1 (Anthrax toxin receptor 1). ANTXRL (Anthrax toxin receptor-like) is a distinct gene product; ANTXR1 is a paralog of ANTXRL, not an ortholog. The rules permit evidence from 'a close ortholog' but not from a paralog in the same species. Even setting aside the gene-identity mismatch, L1 states no residue position for the HA tag — it reports only that 'HA-tagged full-length TEM8 (isoform/variant 1)' was expressed, with no junction coordinates, primer tables, or loop names that would allow insert_after_residue to be pinned or topology-derived. A topology_derived call would require the construct to be of THIS protein (ANTXRL) with exactly one extracellular terminus; L1 does not meet that requirement. No other ledger lines are provided. Accordingly, zero sites qualify.
